controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-zeek.connection-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T10:34:24.500Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T11:34:24.500Z"
| WHERE source.ip == "172.18.0.11" OR destination.ip == "172.18.0.11"
| STATS BY source.ip, destination.ip, destination.port
| SORT destination.port
